tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All conditions are as per tender document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Attested copy of EPF registration certificate and certificate from Regional Provident fund Commissioner regarding successful payment of EPF for the year 2024-25 and 2025-26
Attested copy of ESI Registration certificate and certificate from ESI Deputy Director regarding succesfull payment of ESI for the year 2024-25 and 2025-26

Enclose copy of GST Registration certificate of agency/organization and enclose latest copy of monthly GST returns
I.T Return for the Assessment Year 2025-26
Name of the contractor, office phone, fax, and mobile number, Email ID, and firm fully address .

The intending bidder should have in the last 5 years, achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial of Rs.9.75 Lakhs Usually not less than the estimated annual Payments under this contract. Audited balance sheet certified by the chartered Accountant of two financial years in which required turnover is achieved along with IT returns filed for the said years are to be uploaded. An additional weightage of 10 percentage per year will be added to bring it to the present price level.

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed at least 90 percentage of the Contract Value as a prime contractor at least one similar nature of service such as Providing manpower service costing not less than Rs.4.87 Lakhs
Valid Registration in Labour Department Attested copy of form C registration certificate from labour department The firm should enclose current year valid ceritificate
